description: This PHP file is a sample client implementation for interacting with the TestLink API via XML-RPC. It demonstrates how to report test case results, including steps, timestamps, and metadata, by constructing data objects and making RPC calls to the TestLink server. The file also contains test cases and debugging output to facilitate development and testing of client integrations.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: A generic PHP object used as a dynamic container for test context and execution data.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: A class representing the XML-RPC client used to communicate with the TestLink API server.

methods.name: executeTestCase
methods.description: Sends a test case result report to the TestLink server via XML-RPC with specified context and execution data.
